svg.aria-label: Accuracy against latency, RAM and Flash on the microcontroller, with Pareto fronts
svg.text: On the microcontroller: accuracy against latency and memory (UCI-HAR, NUCLEO-L4R5ZI, Cortex-M4F at 120 MHz)

Each point is one model built for the board and measured there (weights in Flash). Solid line: Pareto front of every build; dashed: front of the ST Edge AI builds alone (same compiler for every model).
WHAR Arena model, ST Edge AI (random weights, cost only)
latency per 3-s window on the board (ms, log scale)
RAM of the model's own objects (KB, log scale)
Flash of the model's own objects: code, weights, constants (KB, log scale)
Not deployable (does not compile, export or fit, or the board's outputs differ from the PC's):

Attend+Discriminate, DANA, DeepConvLSTM, DeepConvLSTM-Attn, DeepConvShallowLSTM, DynamicWHAR, Guan-LSTM, MLP-HAR, MLP-Mixer, SA-HAR, TinierHAR. CNN-HAR needed an export form (LRN as the ONNX operator).
F1: ours over 10 subject splits x 3 seeds, the others from the WHAR Arena paper. Board predictions agree with the PC's on at least 99.7 % of the windows sent, for every build.
